_README: Copy this to focus_001_acceptance.json (gitignored) and edit. If a second person accepts, DELETE the three single_party_* fields - they are only for the ADR-026 exemption, and supplying them when a second party did exist would mark the record weaker than it was.
accepted_by: <<WHO ACCEPTS - must differ from reviewer_identity unless claiming the ADR-026 exemption below>>
single_party_justification: <<AT LEAST 12 WORDS. Why is no second party available? State the circumstance, not just 'solo project', so a later reader can judge whether it still holds.>>
